contract: Default-main and provider-run source reconstruction require provider-reported full_name to identify the requested repository under GitHub case-insensitive repository naming.
Missing, non-string, blank or contradictory provider repository identity rejects before branch-reference, commit or run reads; no fallback to a caller label.
Preserve existing repository ID, branch, ref, commit/tree and run identity checks and external CLI/dataclass contracts.
Use the existing shared identity owner for both real consumers; no parallel resolver or authority family.
Existing synthetic ports must provide the actual mandatory repository fact; do not bypass the new guard in tests.
positive_tests: Matching repository identity including legitimate case changes retains exact source reconstruction.
Existing controller, automation, PR authority, exact-main and run callbacks retain their behavior with complete provider fixtures.
negative_controls: Contradictory/missing/malformed names reject independently in default-main and provider-run reconstruction before later reads.
Explicit metadata from a different repository cannot be converted into the caller-requested repository by correct branch/commit/tree values.
forbidden: Live primary submission bytes and transaction state
Workflow pins and generated authority commits
limits: No certification from source tests or bus reports; integrate only after native scoped source/installed qualification and primary terminal.
Provider endpoint custody remains necessary; metadata consistency alone is not sufficient authentication.
